easy:mcq:1.stem: A printer makes $30$ pages in $5$ minutes at a constant rate. How many pages will it make in $6$ minutes?

distractorNotes.A: A sign error: the size is right but the sign is wrong.
distractorNotes.B: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.
distractorNotes.D: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.

solution: Find the unit rate: $30 div 5 = 6$ pages per minute.
Multiply by 6 minutes: $6 	imes 6 = 36$.
